title: Fieldset: Fieldset with background and border (daisyUI)
notes:
Fieldset is a container for grouping related form elements. It includes fieldset-legend as a title and label as a description.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/fieldset/+page.md
